correctness.rationale: PASS. Starting stationary two-state generator Q and centered velocities, directly inverting the 2x2 Feynman-Kac resolvent gives fourth cumulant κ4=24PΔ^4/r^4[η²A(u)-P B(u)] for P=ab/(a+b)², η=(b-a)/(a+b), u=(a+b)t. The explicit A,B are twice-integrated positive kernels with A=(u²/2)e^-u>0 and B=2e^-u(u-1+e^-u)>0. B/A=4(u-1+e^-u)/u² decreases strictly; twice taking positively weighted means proves R=B/A decreases strictly from2 to1. Hence κ4 negative for η²<=1/5, crosses once negative-to-positive when 1/5<η²<1/3, positive for η²>=1/3, all for t>0; both endpoint equalities strict by 1<R<2. Gaussian independent Brownian forcing has zero fourth cumulant. Independent fourth-moment generator confirms representative rates and times.
